snippet.description:
#NOL인터파크투어 #일본여행 #해외여행 #오사카 #교토

오사카 근교까지 즐길 수 있는 3박 4일 코스 알려줄게. 일단 첫째 날은 오사카의 매력을 느껴보자. 기모노 체험과 오사카성 탐방으로 과거 시간 여행을 떠날 수 있어. 이후에 우메다로 이동해 쇼핑과 먹방을 즐기고 우메다 스카이 빌딩에서 야경을 감상해. 그리고 도톤보리에서 오사카의 첫째 날 밤을 야식과 함께 마무리하면 최고야! 둘째 날은 교토를 정복해 보자. 교토 관광이 시작되는 교토역부터 자연과 인공이 조화를 이루는 힐링 정원 은각사, 산책하기 좋은 철학의 길, 교토의 아름다운 사계절을 한눈에 담을 수 있는 청수사까지! 전통의 멋이 가득한 교토를 즐기며 하나미 코지 도리나 폰토초로 이동해 허기를 채워보자. 특히 폰토초는 오랜 전통 음식과 빈티지한 분위기의 카페들이 몰려 있고 야경도 아름다워 현지인들에게도 인기가 많거든. 다음 여행 일정이 궁금하다면? 고정 댓글을 확인해봐!

en-US.title: Want to make the most of your Osaka trip and even enjoy Kyoto? #shorts
en-US.description:
#NOLInterparkTour #JapanTravel #OverseasTravel #Osaka #Kyoto

I’m going to share a 3-night, 4-day itinerary that allows you to enjoy the Osaka suburbs as well. First, let's experience the charms of Osaka on the first day. You can take a trip back in time by trying on a kimono and exploring Osaka Castle. Afterwards, head to Umeda to enjoy shopping and a food tour, and admire the night view from the Umeda Sky Building. And wrapping up your first night in Osaka with a late-night snack in Dotonbori is the perfect way to end the day! On the second day, let's conquer Kyoto. From Kyoto Station, where sightseeing begins, to Ginkaku-ji Temple—a healing garden where nature and man-made structures harmonize—to the Philosopher's Path, perfect for a stroll, and Kiyomizu-dera Temple, where you can take in Kyoto's beautiful four seasons at a glance! Enjoy Kyoto, full of traditional charm, and head to Hanami Koji Dori or Pontocho to satisfy your hunger. Pontocho, in particular, is popular even among locals because it is home to cafes with vintage atmospheres and long-standing traditional cuisine, as well as beautiful night views. Curious about the next part of the itinerary? Check the pinned comment!

snippet.title: 삿포로 현지인 맛집 추천 best3 #shorts
snippet.description:
#NOL인터파크투어 #일본여행 #삿포로 #삿포로맛집 

미식의 도시 삿포로. 안 가면 후회하는 현지인 추천 맛집 BEST3! 일주일 내내 웨이팅 필수인 '멘야 사이미' 미소 라멘의 원조라 알려진 '스마레'에서 기술을 전수 받아 가게를 오픈했다고 해요 카운터 벽면을 가득 채운 유명인들의 사인이 이곳이 확실한 맛집임을 증명한다고 합니다. 예약 없이는 갈 수 없는 '하치쿄' 최고의 훗카이도산 해산물을 사용해 요리하는 선술집이라고 해요. 그중 최고는 연어알을 가득 올려주는 이쿠라동. 연어알을 흘러내리기 직전까지 부어주는데, 원하는 타이밍에 스탑을 외치면 된다고 합니다. 삿포로를 여행한다면 꼭 가봐야 할 회전 초밥 '도리톤 마루야마 점' 맛집으로 현지 방송에서도 여러 번 소개 된 곳이라고 해요. 당일 잡은 훗카이도산의 신선한 재료만을 사용하며 네타를 두껍게 올려 식감이 일품이라고 합니다. 여기서 꿀팁! 하치쿄의 경우 예약이 필수라고 하니 가기 전 꼭 기억해 두시면 좋을 것 같네요.

en-US.title: Top 3 Recommended Local Restaurants in Sapporo #shorts
en-US.description:
#NOLInterparkTour #JapanTravel #Sapporo #SapporoFood

Sapporo, the city of gourmet food. Here are the BEST 3 local-recommended restaurants you'll regret missing! 'Menya Saimi' is a must-visit, with a wait available all week long. It is said that the restaurant opened after receiving technical training from 'Sumare,' known as the originator of miso ramen. The autographs of celebrities filling the counter wall are said to prove that this is a true gourmet spot. 'Hachikyo' is a place you cannot visit without a reservation. It is an izakaya (Japanese pub) known for using the finest seafood from Hokkaido. The highlight here is the Ikura-don, topped with a generous amount of salmon roe. They pour the roe until it is almost overflowing, and you simply need to shout "Stop" at the moment you want it poured. 'Toriton Maruyama Branch,' a conveyor belt sushi restaurant you must visit if traveling to Sapporo, has been featured multiple times on local TV as a famous eatery. They use only fresh ingredients caught that day from Hokkaido, and the toppings are thick, resulting in an exquisite texture. Here's a great tip! I heard that reservations are essential for Hachikyo, so it would be good to keep that in mind before you go.

아직 봄인데 벌써 여름 휴가냐고요? 인기 휴양지는 지금부터 움직여야 항공권과 숙소를 합리적인 가격에 선점할 수 있어요. 우선 가까운 곳부터 살펴볼까요? 2시간 남짓이면 도착하는 '동양의 하와이' 일본 오키나와입니다! 푸른 바다에서 즐기는 스노클링이 그야말로 일품이에요. 특히 렌터카 여행이 필수인 만큼, 차량이 매진되기 전 지금이 딱 예약 적기예요. 조금 더 이국적인 무드를 원한다면 '신들의 섬' 발리를 추천해요. 건기에 접어드는 여름의 발리는 습도가 낮아 쾌적한 여행이 가능해요. 정글 뷰 숙소나 프라이빗 풀빌라는 예약 경쟁이 치열하니 서둘러 확인해 보세요. 마지막으로 가성비 끝판왕을 찾는다면 역시 태국 푸켓이죠! 저렴한 물가 덕분에 고급 리조트와 로컬 음식을 마음껏 누릴 수 있어요. 일상의 스트레스를 날려버릴 휴식처로 이만한 곳이 없겠죠? 여기서 꿀팁! 여름 휴가 시즌에는 날씨 변수가 있을 수 있으니, 무료 취소가 가능한 상품인지 미리 확인하세요.

en-US.title: If you don't book now, it'll be too late! Top 3 Recommended Summer Vacation Spots #shorts
en-US.description:
#NOLInterparkTour #OverseasTravel #Okinawa #Bali #Phuket #RecommendedTravelDestinations

You might be wondering if it's already summer vacation when it's still spring? For popular resort destinations, you need to start moving now to secure flights and accommodations at reasonable prices. Shall we take a look at nearby destinations first? First up is Okinawa, Japan, known as the "Hawaii of the East," which is just over two hours away! Snorkeling in the blue waters is truly superb. Since renting a car is essential for a trip, now is the perfect time to book before vehicles sell out. If you're looking for a slightly more exotic vibe, I recommend Bali, the "Island of the Gods." As Bali enters its dry season in the summer, the low humidity makes for a pleasant trip. Competition for jungle-view accommodations and private pool villas is fierce, so be sure to check quickly. Finally, if you're looking for the ultimate value for money, it's definitely Phuket, Thailand! Thanks to the affordable cost of living, you can fully enjoy luxury resorts and local cuisine. There is no better place to relax and blow away the stress of everyday life, right? Here's a tip! Since weather can be unpredictable during the summer vacation season, be sure to check in advance if your booking offers free cancellation.

Essential items for traveling around Fukuoka affordably and conveniently. A comprehensive guide to Fukuoka transportation passes! The Fukuoka Tourist City Pass allows unlimited use of Fukuoka city buses and subways, as well as select JR lines, and reportedly offers discounted admission to major attractions. The Subway 1-Day Pass allows unlimited use of the Fukuoka subway for one day; considering the basic fare of 210 yen, it is said to be a bargain even if you ride just four times or more. en-US.description:
#NOLInterparkTour #OverseasTravel #Airplane #FlightTips

Choosing an airplane seat is a must for overseas travel! If you have to choose between a window seat and an aisle seat, which one would you choose? Window seats are recommended for passengers who don't want to miss the scenery outside the window during the flight or those who want to lean back comfortably. However, keep in mind that there is a downside: you have to get up along with the passenger next to you when moving around. Aisle seats are recommended for medium-to-long-haul international flights where you have to sit for a long time. Since your body is bound to get stiff or swollen after a long flight, choosing an aisle seat allows you to stand up and stretch from time to time. Also, it is convenient to use the restroom without asking the person next to you for permission. Window seat vs. Aisle seat: What is your choice when boarding?

en-US.title: A Comprehensive Guide to Tokyo Transportation Passes! Just Know This Before You Go🌟 #shorts #Tokyo
en-US.description:
#NOLInterparkTour #JapanTravel #Tokyo #TokyoTravel

Tokyo's transportation system is just as complex as Osaka's; you shouldn't go without knowing this! Tokyo Subway Tickets can only be purchased by foreigners and are available in 24, 48, and 72-hour options, allowing for unlimited use of the Tokyo Metro and Toei Subway during that time. However, it is said that this does not apply to JR lines. PASMO is a prepaid rechargeable card sold by the Tokyo Metro, identical to Korea's T-money. It allows you to use JR, Tokyo Metro, and buses at discounted prices. Suica is Tokyo's representative transportation card sold by JR and can be used on JR lines, subways, and buses. It offers discounted fares compared to regular tickets and can be used at shops displaying the Suica logo, such as convenience stores and vending machines. The JR Tokunai Pass is a ticket that allows unlimited rides on JR lines (ordinary car, non-reserved seats) within Tokyo's 23 wards for one day, and the entire Yamanote Line, which includes Shinjuku and Shibuya, is free.

en-US.title: Japan Hot Spring Trip♨️ 4 Things You Must Know Before Going to a Ryokan #shorts #ryokan
en-US.description:
#NOLInterparkTour #Japan #HotSprings #JapanTravel

Everything about Japanese hot spring travel and Ryokans! Unlike in Korea, Ryokan rates are calculated based on the number of guests, not the number of rooms. In other words, even if two people share a room, you pay the rate for two. While Ryokans generally feature tatami rooms, there are also some equipped with hotel-style beds. Hot springs include private in-room baths, large communal baths with flowing hot spring water, and open-air baths where you can enjoy nature outdoors. However! You must wash your body before entering the bath! Ryokans provide guests with Yukata, the traditional Japanese attire. When wearing a Yukata, you must ensure the left side is on top and tie the Obi (sash) around the waist. Finally, Kaiseki, the highlight of a Ryokan, is a Japanese-style multi-course meal served using seasonal ingredients; it is said to be the greatest pleasure of a Ryokan, along with the hot spring bath. Here is a helpful tip! Hot springs offer different benefits depending on the water quality, such as being good for joints or skin, so it would be even better to find a bath that suits you, wouldn't it?

en-US.description:
#NOLInterparkTour #Iceland #Aurora

Have you seen Pavane? If you want to see the Icelandic aurora seen in the movie, please watch this video until the end. First, timing is important. The best time to see the Icelandic aurora is from September to April. You must choose clear, cloudless weather, especially during the winter months when the nights are long. Second, check the aurora index. The probability of seeing the aurora is high when the KP index is 3 or higher. It is essential to head to the dark outskirts away from the city lights. Third, here are some recommended spots. I recommend the Grotta Lighthouse near the capital or Kirkjufell, which offers cinematic scenery. Capture a photo that will be remembered for a lifetime against the backdrop of falling stars and the aurora. The final tip to turn your movie dreams into reality! snippet.description:
#NOL인터파크투어 #일본여행 #오사카교통패스

오사카는 교통 시스템이 복잡해 모르고 가면 고생할 수 있으니 꼭 알고 가야 해요. 오사카 주유패스는 교통과 관광지 입장권이 합쳐진 패스권으로 모든 시영 교통이 무료이며 주요 명소 40여 곳에 입장 혜택을 받을 수 있다고 합니다. 라피트 특급 열차는 간사이국제공항에서 난바역까지 환승 없이 34분 만에 도착할 수 있는 특급 열차로 한 열에 3좌석은 슈퍼, 4좌석은 레귤러로 나눠져 있다고 해요. 간사이 공항 리무진은 간사이국제공항에서 주요 도시, 유니버셜 스튜디오까지 이동할 수 있는 리무진 버스로 편안하게 앉아 창밖의 일본 시내를 구경할 수 있다고 해요. 엔조이 에코카드는 오사카에서 운영하는 시영 지하철 메트로와 뉴트램, 버스를 하루 동안 무제한으로 이용할 수 있는 패스로 평일보다 주말, 공휴일 요금이 더 저렴하다고 해요. 여기서 꿀팁! 대부분의 패스는 현지보다 한국이 더 저렴하니 미리 구매하고 가면 좋겠죠?

en-US.title: A Comprehensive Guide to Complex Osaka Transportation Passes! Just Know This Before You Go🌟 #shor...
en-US.description:
#NOLInterparkTour #JapanTravel #OsakaTransportationPass

Osaka's transportation system is complex, so you should definitely check it out before you go, as you might struggle if you don't know the rules. The Osaka Amazing Pass is a combined pass that includes transportation and admission to tourist attractions; it offers free rides on all municipal public transport and provides admission benefits to over 40 major attractions. The Rapit Express train is an express train that can reach Namba Station from Kansai International Airport in just 34 minutes without transfers; it is said that seats in each row are divided into Super (3 seats) and Regular (4 seats). The Kansai Airport Limousine is a limousine bus that travels from Kansai International Airport to major cities and Universal Studios, allowing you to sit comfortably and enjoy the view of downtown Japan outside the window. The Enjoy Eco Card is a pass that allows unlimited use of Osaka's municipal subway (Metro), New Tram, and buses for one day, and fares are cheaper on weekends and holidays than on weekdays. Here's a tip! Most passes are cheaper in Korea than locally, so it's a good idea to purchase them in advance, right?
